messages:
Martha (Sales): Heads-up — AcmeHealth wants to sign by EOD Friday. They asked for a single envelope that includes the MSA + Order Form. Can we stage signature so we countersign the OF first and hold MSA for legal review?
Eli (Legal): We prefer countersigning the OF only if the OF references the MSA version and terms. If they send MSA redlines, we need time. What's the urgency/driver?
Martha (Sales): They need test credits to start a 2-week POC (we committed). Finance will only release credits after a signed doc or PO. Sam, can we accept an OF-only approval path?
Sam (Finance): We can accept OF-only for POC credits if the OF contains pricing, term, and PO number. Need Net30 vs Net45? Also flag: customer wants KMS/HSM language — that may impact billing for Dedicated.
Raj (SE): From a technical presales angle — AcmeHealth requires HSM-backed keys for model logging. They also filled the security questionnaire but flagged key management and data residency. We should confirm scope: is it just encryption at rest or full bring-your-own-keys (BYOK)?
Ava (Security): They asked for HSM-backed KMS and SOC2 attestations. We can provide SOC2 report and standard KMS language, but BYOK/HSM-backed keys require Private deployment or Dedicated with customer-managed KEK. Need to confirm whether they expect Redwood to hold keys.
Martha (Sales): @Eli can we add a short clause in the OF that says "POC access granted subject to pending MSA review" and include sample KMS checkbox? If so we can send DocuSign envelope.
Eli (Legal): We can add a conditional line but must avoid contractual contradictions. Suggest: "Customer acknowledges POC access is subject to execution of the MSA; this OF does not modify the MSA." Also we need to push back on unlimited liability/redline to indemnity cap.
Martha (Sales): Noted. Customer already put a high indemnity cap in the redlines. Can we propose mutual cap at $1M for POC term?
Eli (Legal): Propose mutual cap equal to fees paid in the 12 months or $1M, whichever is higher. I'll draft quick language.
Sam (Finance): Regarding payment: they can issue a PO for the POC credits, we can invoice Net30. If they insist Net45 need manager approval.
Raj (SE): Quick technical note: to enable HSM BYOK in Dedicated we need to set this at provisioning time. That will take ~3 business days and an SOW. Is the customer okay with POC starting on Hosted API while we provision Dedicated?
Martha (Sales): I'll ask them. If they want Hosted for POC we can mask logs and do prefix caching, but not full HSM BYOK.
Ava (Security): For the security questionnaire, we should return answers and include SOC2 report link and our KMS options. I'll attach the file to the envelope.
Martha (Sales): Ok plan: 1) Send OF-only DocuSign envelope with conditional OF clause, PO number field, pricing, Net30 terms, and checkbox for KMS interest; 2) Attach SOC2 + SQ answers; 3) Ask customer if BYOK/HSM required now or post-POC; 4) Legal to follow up on indemnity and MSA redlines.
Eli (Legal): Sounds good. I'll prepare 1-paragraph MSA buffer.
Martha (Sales): Draft OF snippet I'm going to put in DocuSign (feel free to edit):
```
Order Form (POC)
Customer: AcmeHealth
Term: 14 days POC starting on activation
Credits: 5,000 token credits
Price: $0 (trial credits) — invoiced only if customer requests commercial usage
Payment Terms: Net30
PO Number: __________________
KMS required: [ ] Yes [ ] No (if yes, indicate BYOK/HSM and we will follow provisioning SOW)
Signature: Customer Sig -> Redwood countersign
```
Martha (Sales): @Eli @Ava can you quickly review the snippet?
Eli (Legal): Fine but change the Price line: "trial credits provided at no charge for POC; commercial usage requires executed MSA or separate commercial OF." Also add: "This OF does not supersede the MSA."
Ava (Security): Add link to SOC2 and a short note: "KMS options: Redwood-managed keys (default) or dedicated HSM/BYOK (requires Dedicated/Private deployment and provisioning SOW)."
Martha (Sales): Perfect. I'll assemble envelope and send. @esign-bot can you create an envelope with two documents (Order Form + SOC2 attestation) and route to customer then to Eli for countersign? :thumbsup:
esign-bot: Envelope created: envelope_id=env_20260322_01. Sent to customer email on file. Follow-up reminder set for 48h.
Sam (Finance): Once envelope is executed, submit invoice request with PO. I'll fast-track Net30 approval.
Raj (SE): If they confirm BYOK now, loop me in to start provisioning. Otherwise we'll begin Hosted POC config.
Martha (Sales): Thanks team — I'll post updates here after customer reply. :rocket:
